title: MCP server log messages stop reaching the client after moving to protocol 2026-07-28
symptoms: notifications/message from the server no longer appear in the client
Logs arrive only for requests that carry a log level in _meta
cause: 2026-07-28 removes logging/setLevel and ping. A log level now travels per request in _meta as io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel, and servers must not emit notifications/message for requests without it; the Logging feature itself is deprecated.
fix: Send io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel in each request's _meta when you want logs, and keep stderr or your own log pipeline as the main record.
